title: Der grüne Kakadu: Historisch-kritische Ausgabe
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Historical-critical edition of Arthur Schnitzler’s „Der grüne Kakadu“ This edition presents a comprehensive preface analyzing the text genesis, the censoring process as well as the printing history, a transcription of the genetic materials with facsimiles, an edition of the a cesored typescript, a print text with a display of textual variants and a commentary.
